tagline: Three bolsters to lean on, in charcoal and beige tailoring you won't hide from guests.
lead: Your dog gets three sides to rest a head or lean a back against, in a bed that suits the room.
value: Tailored lines in charcoal and beige, so it can stay out when guests arrive, with a zipped cover that comes off to wash.
intro: Starling is a three-sided bolster dog bed with tailored lines, a charcoal-and-beige finish and a cushioned, filled base. The zipped outer cover comes off for washing. Medium, Large and XL.
points: Bolsters frame the bed on three sides, for a resting head or a leaning back.
The filled base is where they actually lie.
Charcoal and beige keep the palette understated.
The outer cover comes off for washing.
best_for: Dogs who lean on three-sided bolsters, and homes with a tailored, neutral palette.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Compare that with the usable space inside the bolsters, not just the outside footprint. Unsure? Ask us.
care: Take the cover off and follow the sewn-in washing instructions. Let it air-dry fully before refitting.
